name: iOS 27
author: Launcher (measured on iOS 27 and tuned on the S24)
_about: The iOS 27 animation preset: every motion role (motion.*) as a spring or a bezier curve. Written by tools/design/build_ios27_theme.py (its seeds); kept as edited here once written.

motion.app.cancel.src: judged:a home drag that does not commit: back to the app

motion.app.close-position.src: measured:tuned on the S24 (launch and close "really smooth", close elasticity reduced on request); position and size on their own springs, as iOS

motion.app.close-size.src: measured:tuned on the S24 (launch and close "really smooth", close elasticity reduced on request)

motion.app.open.src: measured:tuned on the S24 (launch and close "really smooth", close elasticity reduced on request)

motion.appear.src: judged:something new on home growing into its place

motion.appear.fade.src: judged:something arriving fading in (Android's default ease, as the code ran it before B3)

motion.appearance.change.src: judged:light and dark crossfading (a shorter way back takes part of it); as the code timed it before B3

motion.arrival.src: judged:home arriving (after unlock, after a cold start): zooming out to rest

motion.arrival.hold.src: judged:home easing into the arrival's first frame while the unlock holds it (smoothstep); as the code timed it before B3

motion.arrival.wallpaper.src: judged:the wallpaper settling on a cold start

motion.arrival.zoom.src: judged:how far home is zoomed when it starts arriving

motion.banner.app-fade.src: judged:a banner's glass taking the picture of the app behind it (smoothstep); as the code timed it before B3

motion.banner.back.src: judged:a dragged banner let go: back

motion.banner.fly-fade.src: judged:a flung banner fading as it goes

motion.banner.in.src: judged:a banner swooping in from the top

motion.card.catch-up.src: judged:a late card gliding from full screen to the finger (cubic ease-out); as the code timed it before B3

motion.card.color.src: judged:a launching card's colour blending into the app's real launch-screen colour; as the code timed it before B3

motion.card.fade-app.src: judged:the card fading into the app at the end of a launch; as the code timed it before B3

motion.card.fade-home.src: judged:the card fading into home at the end of a close; as the code timed it before B3

motion.card.snapshot.src: judged:a snapshot that arrived while its card shows fading in over it (cubic ease-out); as the code timed it before B3

motion.cc.backdrop-hold.src: judged:Control Center's live background turning into a still picture before an app starts from it (decelerating); as the code timed it before B3

motion.cc.close.src: measured:iOS 27 (docs/IOS27_MOTION.md): Control Center closing takes ~0.18 s

motion.cc.close-style.src: judged:Control Center's closing choreography blending in and out

motion.cc.expanded.open.src: judged:a module growing into its expanded form

motion.cc.level.src: judged:a slider's level following the system's

motion.cc.lift.src: judged:a control lifted to be dragged

motion.cc.open.src: judged:Matheesha wants the opening seen; it was 0.3 / 1 (iOS: in within ~75 ms of a quick pull)

motion.cc.reflow.src: judged:controls making room in edit mode

motion.cc.settle.src: measured:iOS 27 (docs/IOS27_MOTION.md): the controls settle, overshooting a little

motion.cc.stretch-back.src: judged:the grid stretched by an overpull, back

motion.cc.toggle.src: judged:a control turning on or off

motion.clock.appear.src: judged:the glass clock's numerals fading in (a first showing, a new size); as the code timed it before B3

motion.clock.tick.src: judged:the clock's numerals crossfading at the minute change

motion.debug.slow.src: judged:slow motion for checking animations frame by frame (1 = normal; every spring's period is stretched by it)

motion.disappear.fade.src: judged:something leaving fading (Android's default ease, as the code ran it before B3)

motion.edit.bar.src: judged:the edit bar sliding in from the top and out

motion.edit.jiggle-stop.src: judged:icons coming to rest when edit mode ends; as the code timed it before B3

motion.edit.reflow.src: judged:icons making room for a dragged one

motion.field.clear-in.src: judged:a search field's clear button popping in (Android's overshoot 1.6, exactly); as the code timed it before B3

motion.field.clear-out.src: judged:a search field's clear button shrinking away (accelerating); as the code timed it before B3

motion.home.content-zoom.src: judged:home behind an open app: icons zoom more than the wallpaper (the sense of depth)

motion.home.depth-blur.src: judged:home blurred when it has fully receded behind an open app

motion.home.depth-close.src: judged:home comes forward again on close

motion.home.depth-open.src: judged:home recedes behind an opening app

motion.home.label-tone.src: judged:names and the clock turning light or dark with a new wallpaper (as gently as the wallpaper changes)

motion.home.page-fling.src: judged:a fling faster than this (dp/s) turns the page even when it has moved only a little

motion.home.pill-edit.src: judged:the Search pill becoming the page dots in edit mode, and back; as the code timed it before B3

motion.home.pill-hide.src: judged:home's Search pill turning into the page dots while the pages move; as the code timed it before B3

motion.home.pill-show.src: judged:the page dots turning back into the Search pill; as the code timed it before B3

motion.home.wallpaper-zoom.src: judged:the wallpaper behind an open app

motion.icon.press-dim.src: judged:touching an icon dims it (iOS), instead of shrinking it

motion.icon.press-in.src: judged:the dim coming (Android's default ease, as the code ran it before B3)

motion.icon.press-out.src: judged:the dim going (Android's default ease, as the code ran it before B3)

motion.index.scroll.src: judged:the A-Z index: the list gliding to a letter's section

motion.menu.close.src: judged:closing is quicker and does not bounce

motion.menu.open.src: judged:the item lifts, home blurs and the menu grows on one spring (UIContextMenuInteraction)

motion.mode-crossfade.src: judged:the App Library's tiles and list, and Spotlight's suggestions and results, crossfading (Android's default ease, as the code ran it before B3)

motion.nc.appear.src: judged:a notification arriving in the list

motion.nc.clock-tick.src: judged:the clock's numerals crossfading at the minute

motion.nc.confirm.src: judged:a group's clear button turning into Clear

motion.nc.hold.src: judged:the flashlight and camera buttons growing while held

motion.nc.launch-fade.src: judged:the card of an app opened from Notification Center fading into the app; as the code timed it before B3

motion.nc.menu-open.src: judged:a notification held: the long look opening

motion.nc.reflow.src: judged:the list's notifications moving to new places

motion.nc.swipe-back.src: judged:a swiped notification let go: back

motion.nc.time-fade.src: judged:a notification's time label crossfading to its new text; as the code timed it before B3

motion.press-in.src: judged:a platter or a button pressed (Notification Center, banners)

motion.sheet.src: judged:a sheet presenting and dismissing (the widget gallery)

motion.sheet.push.src: judged:a page pushed inside a sheet

motion.statusbar.hide.src: judged:the bar fading (and lifting a touch) when the app in front is full screen; as the code timed it before B3

motion.statusbar.lock.src: judged:the bar's time fading over the lock screen, and back; as the code timed it before B3

motion.statusbar.roll.src: judged:a digit rolling to the next

motion.statusbar.show.src: judged:the bar coming back when the app in front leaves full screen; as the code timed it before B3

motion.statusbar.tone.src: judged:the bar's content turning dark or light; as the code timed it before B3

motion.strip.hide.src: judged:the gesture bar's pill fading while a panel of the shade is open; as the code timed it before B3

motion.strip.show.src: judged:and coming back; as the code timed it before B3

motion.switch.commit.src: judged:a sideways switch to the next app

motion.switcher.card-center-y.src: measured:the same (its vertical centre, of the screen's height)

motion.switcher.card-scale.src: measured:Apple's illustration of the iOS 27 App Switcher (card size, of the screen)

motion.switcher.clear-home.src: judged:Clear all: home after the last card; as the code timed it before B3

motion.switcher.clear-stagger.src: judged:Clear all: each card flicked away after the one before; as the code timed it before B3

motion.switcher.flick.src: judged:a card flicked up and away

motion.switcher.flick-speed.src: judged:faster than this (dp/s), or a third of its height

motion.switcher.fling-projection.src: judged:how far ahead (s) a throw is projected to choose a card

motion.switcher.focus-left.src: measured:the same (the focused card's left edge, of its width)

motion.switcher.hold.src: judged:the finger resting this long during a home swipe opens the deck

motion.switcher.hold-travel.src: judged:at least this far (dp) above where the swipe started

motion.switcher.scroll.src: judged:scrolling to rest on a card

motion.wallpaper.appear.src: judged:the wallpaper fading in when it is read after home is on screen; as the code timed it before B3

motion.wallpaper.crossfade.src: judged:a new wallpaper crossfading in (where its reveal cannot be drawn); as the code timed it before B3

motion.wallpaper.reveal.src: judged:a new wallpaper's reveal (starts gently, eases out); as the code timed it before B3

motion.widget.layout-fade.src: judged:a widget's new layout crossfading in after a resize (quadratic ease-out); as the code timed it before B3

motion.widget.resize.src: judged:a widget changing size (the content crossfades)

motion.widgets.preview.src: judged:a widget preview fading in; as the code timed it before B3

motion.widgets.row.src: judged:the widget gallery's rows arriving or moving (their fade and rise are shaped on this timeline); as the code timed it before B3

motion.widgets.row-stagger.src: judged:each of the widget gallery's rows arriving after the one above; as the code timed it before B3
